evidence.method: existing harness locate_quote: NFC + whitespace collapse only, no fuzzy matching

support.method: deterministic conservative check: located claim quote must contain the assigned track's keyword family / the assigned function class's cue phrase (committed config files). False means 'cue absent from the quote', NOT 'label wrong'.
support.arm_a_circularity_note: Arm A's evidence spans are the rule match that produced its label, so its support rate is circular by construction and is NOT independent evidence.

abstention.note: Arm A has no abstain field: 'abstained' is derived by the evaluator as function_class==UNCLASSIFIED and track_id==UNCLASSIFIED.

negative_control.definition: false positive = the arm asserted a technology track OR an R&D function class (CORE_R&D, CLINICAL_R&D, PRODUCT_ENGINEERING, ALGORITHM_SOFTWARE, HARDWARE_SYSTEMS) for a title-declared non-technical posting

A.precision_recall_f1: NOT_EVALUABLE: no human gold standard exists for this corpus
A.confidence_calibration: NOT_AVAILABLE: rule-derived strength / qualitative note, not a calibrated probability

C.reason: NOT_RUN: the only existing QLoRA adapter (PR #20, overnight-2026-11-04) was trained on regulatory-event text under the frozen event schema (event category, three timestamps, company entity, product). Job text is a different task with a different output contract, and the adapter was never trained on job postings. Running it would measure schema/task incompatibility, not job-text extraction capability, so arm C produces no number here. This is a statement about the experiment design, not about the model.

comparison.reason: need both arm A and arm B predictions on the same items

caveats: NOT_EVALUABLE: no human gold standard exists for this corpus
NOT_AVAILABLE: rule-derived strength / qualitative note, not a calibrated probability
Negative controls are selected by a declared title pattern; the set is small and is not a representative sample of all non-technical postings.
Cue-support is a lower-bound deterministic check, not human adjudication; the manual adjudication table in this directory is the only human judgement in this experiment.
Arm A's evidence support is circular (the evidence span is the rule that fired).
Single snapshot (T0): no trend, no lag test, no claim about the company's R&D direction.
